methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched via WebFetch on 2026-06-15 for each vendor: brand24.com/prices/, awario.com/pricing/, mention.com/en/pricing/, buzzsumo.com/pricing/, sproutsocial.com/pricing/, brandwatch.com/plans/, meltwater.com/en/pricing, and talkwalker.com/pricing. Prices shown reflect the default annual-billing toggle where applicable; monthly-billing equivalents are noted in plan notes when published. Brandwatch, Meltwater, and Talkwalker do not publish self-serve prices and are listed as quote-only (monthlyUsd:null). Compliance flags are set true only where an official statement was found (Sprout Social security page; Meltwater SOC 2 Type II press release + Trust Center; Talkwalker security-practices page); otherwise null. Brand24 GDPR retained per vendor docs; Brandwatch SOC 2 downgraded to null as it was not explicitly confirmed on an official page in this check. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Brand24
vendors.provenance: Re-verified at brand24.com/prices/ on 2026-06-15. Annual prices (199/299/399/599; Enterprise from 1,499) and monthly toggles (249/349/499/699) confirmed.

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: 3 keywords, 2,000 mentions/month, 1 user, 12-hour updates, AI Sentiment Analysis. $249/mo when billed monthly.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: 7 keywords, 10,000 mentions/month, unlimited users, hourly updates, priority support. $349/mo when billed monthly.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 12 keywords, 40,000 mentions/month, unlimited users, real-time updates, Lightning Search, AI Events Detection, AI Brand Assistant, AI Insights (2 projects). $499/mo when billed monthly.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 25 keywords, 100,000 mentions/month, unlimited users, real-time updates, AI Insights (5 projects), unlimited AI Topics, Client Success Lead, Advanced Reports. $699/mo when billed monthly.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom keywords and mentions, unlimited users, full AI feature access, dedicated consulting, Advanced Reports. Billed annually only; starts from $1,499/mo.

limits: 3-25 keywords depending on plan
2,000-100,000 mentions/month by tier
1 user on Individual; unlimited on all others
keyFeatures: AI Sentiment Analysis across all plans
AI Brand Assistant and AI Events Detection on Pro+
enrichment.provenance: Fetched from brand24.com/prices/. GDPR referenced in vendor security/product docs; SOC 2 and HIPAA not explicitly stated on an official page checked, left null.

vendors.name: Mention
vendors.provenance: Re-verified at mention.com/en/pricing/ on 2026-06-15. Company plan at $599/mo (annual) is the sole self-serve plan for new customers; legacy self-serve tiers were discontinued. Publish/Respond (publishing & engagement) features retired Jan 30, 2026 — product is now listening-only.

plans.name: Company
plans.notes: Real-time monitoring across 1 billion+ sources, social tracking (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, Reddit, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube), web monitoring (news/blogs/forums), review site monitoring (75+ platforms), advanced Boolean search, sentiment analysis, competitor benchmarking, custom reporting, share of voice, dedicated account manager. ~50K mentions/month. Billed annually (no month-to-month option); page notes ~$360/yr saving vs no annual commitment. Historical data and API are paid add-ons.

vendors.name: Sprout Social
vendors.provenance: Re-verified at sproutsocial.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-15. Per-seat pricing. Essentials $79 annual / $99 monthly; Standard $199 annual ($249 monthly); Professional $299 annual; Advanced $399 annual; Enterprise custom. Social Listening is a paid add-on (quote-based).

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per seat/user. 5 social profiles, optimal send times, profile and post-level reporting. $99/seat/mo when billed monthly. No listening included.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Per seat/user. 5 social profiles, consolidated inbox, collaboration tools, keyword/location monitoring, unlimited AI alt text, review management. $249/seat/mo when billed monthly. Social Listening add-on available at extra cost (quote-based).

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Per seat/user; displayed rate is annual billing. Unlimited profiles, message tagging, competitor/tag/paid insights, AI Assist for posts. Monthly-billing rate is higher and not itemized on the page. Social Listening add-on available.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per seat/user; displayed rate is annual billing. Everything in Professional plus AI Assist for replies, sentiment analysis, Sprout API, helpdesk integrations, productivity reports, message spike alerts. Monthly-billing rate is higher and not itemized on the page. Social Listening add-on available.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Everything in Advanced plus white-glove onboarding, dedicated SSO support, priority customer service. Contact sales.

plans.name: Social Listening Add-On
plans.notes: Add-on to Standard plan and above. Sentiment tracking, spike alerts, smart categories. Pricing not published — requires custom quote based on data volume and topics tracked.
